podcast.body: The speaker's initial knowledge of Depeche Mode was limited to "People Are People," which was the only one of their songs that achieved Top 40 status across Canada. He learned more about the band by exploring the CFNY music library. "the only song I knew was People Are People because that was the only top 40 song across Canada."
